spec.title: CPU Cores
spec.description: Logical cores per node. Inventory, not a measurement -- it changes only when a VM is resized.

spec.expr: count by (nodename) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", cluster=~"$cluster"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) (rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * 100 * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

100 - (avg by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"})) * 100)

100 - (avg by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"})) * 100)

max by (nodename, device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename, device) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat",mountpoint!~"/var/lib/docker/.*|/boot/efi|/boot/firmware"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat",mountpoint!~"/var/lib/docker/.*|/boot/efi|/boot/firmware"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename, mountpoint) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat",mountpoint!~"/var/lib/docker/.*|/boot/efi|/boot/firmware"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

sort_desc((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat",mountpoint!~"/var/lib/docker/.*|/boot/efi|/boot/firmware"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat",mountpoint!~"/var/lib/docker/.*|/boot/efi|/boot/firmware"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}) * 100)

max by (nodename) (rate(node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * 100 * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) (rate(node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * 100 * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

spec.title: Load Average per CPU
spec.description: Run-queue length divided by the node's CPU count -- the fraction of CPUs with work waiting, so 100% is saturated regardless of node size (red line). Raw load averages are not comparable across this cluster: k0s-cp1 has 2 CPUs against 10 on the workers, so the same load1 of 0.08 is 13.5%/CPU on cp1 vs 0.9% on worker1.

spec.expr: max by (nodename) (node_load1{cluster=~"$cluster"} / on(instance) group_left() count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) (node_load5{cluster=~"$cluster"} / on(instance) group_left() count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) (node_load15{cluster=~"$cluster"} / on(instance) group_left() count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) (rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * 100 * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) (rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * 100 * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))
max by (nodename) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) ((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))
max by (nodename) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

max by (nodename) ((1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}) * 100)

spec.title: Network I/O
spec.description: Traffic across each node's physical interfaces. The CNI's per-pod veths and Cilium's own devices are excluded, so pod traffic is counted once, where it leaves the node, rather than again on every virtual hop.

spec.expr: sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|lxc.*|cilium_.*"} [$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|lxc.*|cilium_.*"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))

spec.title: Pods Running
spec.description: Worker nodes only -- k0s controllers run no kubelet unless started with --enable-worker, so a control-plane node is absent here, not zero.

spec.expr: sum by (nodename) (kubelet_running_pods{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on(node) group_left(nodename) (label_replace(max by (nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)")))

spec.title: Time Until Filesystem Full
spec.description: Days until free space reaches zero, projected from the last 7 days. Capped at 3650 d; filesystems that are not filling are omitted.

spec.expr: sort(clamp_max((node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat",mountpoint!~"/var/lib/docker/.*|/boot/efi|/boot/firmware"} / deriv(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs|vfat",mountpoint!~"/var/lib/docker/.*|/boot/efi|/boot/firmware"}[7d]) / -86400) > 0, 3650) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))
max by (nodename) ((time() - node_boot_time_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}))
